description: Read and search messages and threads, list channels and users, and send, edit, delete, react to, pin and upload files, plus manage channels and DMs on *.slack.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Slack session.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Slack channel or thread

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit an existing Slack message. The caller must be the original author of the message.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a Slack message. The caller must be the original author, or the channel must allow message deletion.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Slack channel with optional date-range filtering and pagination

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read replies in a Slack thread. Returns all messages including the parent message, with optional pagination.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search for messages across Slack channels with optional pagination and sorting

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List channels in the Slack workspace with optional pagination

tools.name: get_channel_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Slack channel including topic, purpose, and member count

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel

tools.name: set_channel_topic
tools.description: Set the topic of a Slack channel

tools.name: set_channel_purpose
tools.description: Set the purpose of a Slack channel

tools.name: invite_to_channel
tools.description: Invite a user to a Slack channel

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List member user IDs of a Slack channel with optional pagination. Returns user IDs only — use get_user_profile to resolve a specific user ID to a name/profile, or list_users to get all workspace users with names.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a Slack user's profile information by user ID

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace with optional pagination

tools.name: open_dm
tools.description: Open a direct message conversation with one or more users. Returns an existing DM channel if one already exists, or creates a new one. For multi-person DMs (group DMs), pass multiple comma-separated user IDs.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a Slack channel

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a Slack channel or workspace with optional filters

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message to a Slack channel

tools.name: unpin_message
tools.description: Unpin a message from a Slack channel
